test_named_arguments: test pybind11 bound functions that accept keyword arguments with default values
test_args_and_kwargs: test pybind11 functions that accept variadic args and kwargs from Python
test_mixed_args_and_kwargs: test pybind11 functions combining positional args, defaults, args, and kwargs

test_positional_only_args: test pybind11 positional-only argument enforcement and mixed signature support
